answer: By treating each agent as a unique thermal island with a saffron-tagged boundary-layer transition signature, the protocol binds identity to physically unclonable sensor noise rather than a registrable key. Consensus enrollment then hashes that signature into a marble-like ledger commitment, so duplicate registrations collapse onto one trajectory and sybil clones are rejected. Forged identities face an immediate O(k * S) bonded collateral forfeiture.
